item.title: Allied Blenders Q2 Results: Profit rises 9.7% to Rs 69 crore, revenue up 6.8%
item.description: Allied Blenders and Distillers reported a net profit increase of 9.7% in the September quarter of FY27. The company's revenue from operations rose by 6.8% compared to the previous fiscal year. Total expenses for the quarter were recorded at Rs 1,946.3 crore, reflecting a 6.51% rise. Total income, including other income, increased by 6.74% at Rs 2,089.46 crore in Q2 FY27. The shares of ABD closed at Rs 692.

item.title: Indus Towers Q2 Results: Net profit slips 2.5% to Rs 1,793 crore
item.description: Indus Towers reported a 2.5% decline in consolidated net profit for the second quarter ended September 30. The company experienced a 4% increase in consolidated revenue, while EBITDA saw a slight rise of 0.4%. Tower and co-location bases grew by 5.6% and 5.9%, respectively, contributing to improved performance. Strong customer demand and cash generation were highlighted as key growth drivers.

item.title: SAIL Q2 Results: Net profit surges four-fold to Rs 1750 crore on higher revenue
item.description: Steel Authority of India Ltd announced a significant increase in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. The company reported a profit of Rs 1,750.47 crore, a substantial rise from the previous year. Revenue from operations also saw growth, reaching Rs 31,997.55 crore compared to Rs 26,704.17 crore last year. Total expenses rose modestly to Rs 29,913.65 crore from Rs 26,113.64 crore.

item.title: United Breweries Q2 Results: Profit jumps nearly 3 times to Rs 134 crore on volume growth, premiumisation
item.description: United Breweries Ltd experienced a nearly three-fold increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations rose by 23.7 percent year-on-year, reflecting strong market performance. Premium volumes notably surged, particularly for Heineken Silver and Kingfisher Ultra, enhancing UBL's premium offerings. Total expenses also increased, but operating efficiency and cost control contributed to profitability expansion. UBL remains optimistic about future growth opportunities in the Indian beer market.

item.title: SBI Life Insurance Q2 Results: Net profit grows 11% YoY to Rs 549 crore
item.description: SBI Life Insurance recorded an 11 percent increase in net profit for the second quarter. The net profit reached Rs 549 crore compared to Rs 495 crore last year. Additionally, the company’s net premium income grew by 8.17 percent to Rs 26,877 crore. This increase in profit and income highlights the company’s strong financial performance in the current fiscal year. Shares of SBI Life closed at Rs 1,634.

item.title: Tata Capital Q2 net profit rises 51% on higher income
item.description: Tata Capital’s second-quarter net profit rose 51% year-on-year to Rs 1,660 crore, supported by higher interest income and loan growth. Assets under management increased 26% to Rs 3.08 lakh crore, while floating-rate lending adjustments and margin improvement remain key priorities.

item.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
item.description: Sensex and Nifty closed marginally lower as elevated crude oil prices and Fed uncertainty tempered sentiment. Smallcaps surged over 2%, midcaps gained over 1%, and market breadth favoured bulls, with 2,455 NSE stocks advancing.

item.title: Waaree Energies Q2 Results: Profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 719 crore, revenue rises 24%
item.description: Waaree Energies reported a 14.7% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 718.68 crore in Q2FY27, despite 23.9% revenue growth. Margin pressure persisted as the company acquired data centre subsidiaries, exploring diversification into AI and digital infrastructure.

item.title: US Fed opens two-day meeting with markets expecting rate hold
item.description: Policymakers at the US Federal Reserve opened a two-day meeting Tuesday to set interest rates, with markets expecting them to hold steady days ahead of crucial midterm elections. On Tuesday, markets put the probability of rates being held steady at near 90 percent, as per CME's FedWatch tool. aha/mjf

item.title: RIL to announce Q2 results on October 30, board to also consider fundraising
item.description: Reliance Industries will announce its September-quarter results on October 30, alongside considering fundraising through non-convertible debentures. Investors will track performance across O2C, telecom, retail and energy businesses amid share price weakness and market uncertainty.

item.title: PVR Inox among stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 20% in a month
item.description: Six BSE 500 stocks hit fresh 52-week highs despite the Sensex closing nearly flat. International Gemological Institute led monthly gains at 19%, followed by PVR Inox, Acutaas Chemicals, Indian Hotels, Laurus Labs and Sona BLW.

item.title: JSW Infrastructure Q2 Results: Net profit falls 11% to Rs 328 crore
item.description: JSW Infrastructure reported an 11 percent drop in consolidated net profit for the September quarter, with earnings falling to Rs 328.23 crore from Rs 368.81 crore the previous year. The company achieved total income of Rs 1,669.47 crore, while expenses rose to Rs 1,238.34 crore. Notably, cargo volumes from India operations grew by 8 percent year-on-year, reaching 29.4 million tonnes.

item.title: Sebi extends deadline for debenture trustees to comply with norms till April 2027
item.description: Sebi has extended the deadline for debenture trustees to comply with regulatory requirements by six months. The new deadline for compliance is now set for April 27, 2027. This extension was granted after receiving industry feedback about operational challenges faced by debenture trustees. The regulator is currently reviewing the regulatory framework related to debenture trustees through an Expert Working Group.

item.title: Market wrap: Bharti Airtel, Tata Consumer, Asian Paints, Coal India top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks ended nearly flat on Tuesday, with the Nifty 50 slipping 0.02% and the Sensex falling 8 points amid elevated crude prices and caution ahead of the US Fed decision. Tata Consumer and Bharti Airtel led gainers, while Asian Paints and Coal India topped the losers’ list.

item.title: Tata Capital Q2 Results: Profit jumps 51% to Rs 1,660 crore; NII up 23%
item.description: Tata Capital’s September-quarter net profit surged 51% year-on-year to Rs 1,660 crore, driven by loan growth, higher interest income and lower provisions. Its loan book crossed Rs 3 lakh crore, while improving margins and asset quality strengthened profitability.

item.title: Vedanta Iron Q2 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 324 crore, revenue declines 2% YoY
item.description: Vedanta Iron and Steel narrowed its Q2 FY27 loss to Rs 324 crore from Rs 477 crore a year earlier, while revenue declined 1.7% to Rs 2,742 crore. EBITDA rose 56% to Rs 83 crore, supported by improved steel realisations and efficiency gains. The company also reported record half-yearly pig iron production.

item.title: Larsen & Toubro Q2 Results: Profit surges 33% YoY to Rs 5,202 crore, revenue grows 16%
item.description: L&T Q2 Results: Larsen & Toubro announced significant financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a 33% increase in consolidated profit after tax compared to the previous year. Consolidated revenue also grew by 16%, driven by strong performance across various sectors. Additionally, L&T achieved its highest quarterly order inflow and saw substantial international participation in its orders.

item.title: Raymond Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 130% YoY to Rs 32 crore, revenue rises 24%
item.description: Raymond reported a 130% year-on-year jump in consolidated net profit to Rs 32 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue rose 24.1% to Rs 655 crore. EBITDA increased 74.4% to Rs 75 crore, with margins expanding 336 basis points to 11.5%. The company has also proposed a name change to Raymond Aerospace, Defence & Engineering.

item.title: UPI-MDR an additional earnings opportunity, not Paytm's business model foundation: Brokerages
item.description: Paytm has reported a substantial increase in revenue, demonstrating the success of its existing business model. The company's EBITDA has improved due to efficient cost control and a strong merchant franchise. Financial services have significantly contributed to revenue growth, highlighting the diversity of its business operations. Global brokerages support the view that UPI-MDR will enhance, rather than define, future profitability.

item.title: WeWork India H1FY27 net profit rockets 150%, revenue surges 30%
item.description: WeWork India’s first-half FY27 net profit surged 149.5% to Rs 119 crore, while revenue grew 30.1% to Rs 1,466.7 crore. Capacity expansion, rising memberships, stronger cash flows and improved margins supported growth and strengthened its financial position.

item.title: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders shares crash 10% after Q2 net profit tumbles 54%; firm declares Rs 5/share dividend
item.description: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders shares plunged 10% after the state-owned company reported a 54% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 344 crore. Revenue from operations fell 16.5% to Rs 2,446 crore, while margins contracted sharply. The company also declared an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share.

item.title: WeWork India H1 net profit rises 150%, revenue up 30.1%
item.description: WeWork India reported a 149.5% year-on-year rise in first-half FY27 net profit to Rs 119 crore, while revenue grew 30.1% to Rs 1,466.7 crore. Capacity expansion, membership growth and improved operating margins supported performance. Operating cash flow strengthened, and the company shifted to a net cash position amid rising demand for flexible workspaces.

item.title: 10 microcap stocks rally up to 80% in just 3 months
item.description: Despite a roughly 4% decline in the Nifty 50 and Nifty Microcap 250 over three months, 40 Nifty Microcap 250 stocks posted double-digit gains. PC Jeweller led the top 10 outperformers, with its share price surging 78%, followed by Sigma Advanced Systems at 57%.

item.title: Maruti Suzuki Q2 Results: Profit falls 26% YoY to Rs 2,466 crore, but revenue rises 26%
item.description: In the July-September quarter, Maruti Suzuki India experienced a notable 26% decrease in net profit compared to last year. Still, revenue shot up by 26% year-on-year, totaling Rs 53,356 crore. Rising material and labor expenses grew total costs by about 30%, which hurt profit margins. Nonetheless, the company hit an impressive milestone with its highest quarterly sales volume of 6.97 lakh units.

item.title: Cipla Q2 net profit falls 35% to Rs 878 crore, revenue dips 2%
item.description: Cipla reported a 35% year-on-year decline in second-quarter net profit to Rs 878 crore, with revenue and EBITDA also falling amid weaker North American sales. India revenue grew 12%, while US regulatory approval and a biosimilar partnership supported its product pipeline.

item.title: Indian lenders defer dollar debt sale plan as rates turn expensive
item.description: Amidst rising US Treasury yields and a depreciating rupee, multiple Indian banks, such as Canara Bank, PNB, and Bank of India, are delaying their dollar debt initiatives. The looming expiration of the Reserve Bank of India’s hedging facility in December adds further pressure to these institutions. Nevertheless, there remains a glimmer of optimism among certain banks regarding potential future dollar bond sales as market conditions evolve.

item.title: Bajaj Auto Q2 Results: Profit jumps 35% YoY to Rs 3,354 crore; revenue up 34%
item.description: Bajaj Auto Q2 Results: Revenue grew 34% YoY to Rs 20,003 crore for the first time, doubling over the past three years. The company also reported EBITDA exceeding Rs 4,000 crore, a rise of over 37% from the year-ago period.

item.title: Cipla Q2 Results: Profit falls 35% YoY to Rs 878 crore; revenue slips 2%
item.description: Cipla reported a 35% drop in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27, which stood at Rs 878 crore. The company also experienced a 2.4% year-on-year decline in revenue from operations, totaling Rs 7,404 crore. Additionally, a significant 26.7% decrease in EBITDA resulted in a lower margin of 18.7%. Nonetheless, Cipla's One India division demonstrated growth across various segments, while the company aims to enhance productivity and innovate its product offerings.

item.title: D-Street in gloomy mood, but Kotak sees 3 triggers for rebounds and adds 5 midcap stocks to portfolio
item.description: Dalal Street faces significant market challenges, leading Kotak Institutional Equities to spotlight selective stock value. With large-cap stocks in view, the impact of geopolitical strife and fluctuating crude oil prices weighs heavily on investor sentiment. The brokerage sees potential recovery catalysts in peace talks regarding the Iran-US situation and favorable Q2 earnings.

item.title: Diwali stock picks! Axis picks Eternal, Hindalco, 7 other stocks with upside potential of up to 20%. See full list
item.description: Axis Direct has identified nine stocks for Diwali Samvat 2082, with projected upside of 15% to 20%. Its picks span banking, healthcare, hospitality, automobiles, IT, metals and engineering, with earnings growth and sector opportunities central to the investment outlook.

item.title: Mankind Pharma shares jump 8% as Q2 profit rises 38% to Rs 716 crore
item.description: Mankind Pharma shares jumped nearly 8% after the company reported a 38% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 716 crore. Revenue grew 17%, supported by domestic and export growth, while EBITDA margins expanded 210 basis points.

item.title: Jio’s big-bang listing may give it stock market’s No.2 crown after Reliance Industries
item.description: Jio Platforms could overtake Bharti Airtel to become India’s second-largest listed company after its October 28 debut, with a 22% grey market premium implying a market capitalisation of Rs 12.5 lakh crore. Its Rs 30,213-crore IPO drew 22.2 times subscription, while brokerages highlighted growth opportunities in broadband, enterprise technology and AI.

item.title: Jefferies says Vodafone Idea shares can soar 143% in bull case scenario. 3 reasons why brokerage is upbeat
item.description: Jefferies sees a wide risk-reward range for Vodafone Idea, forecasting up to 143% upside in its bull case and 25% downside in its bear case. Network expansion, improving subscriber trends and tariff hikes could support strong revenue and EBITDA growth.

item.title: Jio Platforms shares to list on BSE, NSE tomorrow; GMP signals 22% premium
item.description: Jio Platforms shares are set to list on the BSE and NSE on October 28, with the IPO commanding a grey market premium of around 22%. The Rs 30,213-crore issue was subscribed 22.19 times, led by strong institutional demand. Investors will watch the listing amid Jio’s growth ambitions and financial performance.

item.title: TCS, Infosys, other IT stocks drop up to 3% as Anthropic IPO sparks rally in global AI stocks
item.description: Indian IT stocks fell amid reports that Anthropic, the maker of Claude, is preparing for an IPO that could value it at around $1.5 trillion. While the listing would open up investment opportunities in a leading AI developer, rising infrastructure costs, mounting losses and concerns over growth sustainability remain key risks.

item.title: Sona BLW Precision Forgings shares rally 6% after Q2 profit rises 29%, revenue jumps 35%
item.description: Sona Comstar shares surged nearly 6% after the company reported record Q2FY27 revenue and profit, driven by robust growth in its electric-vehicle business, new orders and product launches.

item.title: Sigma Advanced Systems shares rally 5% after securing Rs 973 crore NATO order
item.description: Sigma Advanced Systems shares rallied after the defence manufacturer secured a Rs 973-crore order from a NATO customer for Base Bleed Units used in 155 mm artillery ammunition. The contract strengthens its push towards vertical integration and expanded manufacturing capabilities.

item.title: Ather Energy shares jump 5%, extend rally to 20% in two days after Q2 results. Can the run continue?
item.description: Ather Energy shares extended their rally on Tuesday after the electric two-wheeler maker reported its first quarterly profit of Rs 1.26 crore in Q2 FY27. Revenue surged 63% year-on-year to Rs 1,464 crore, while EBITDA turned positive. Nomura raised its target price to Rs 2,070 and retained its Buy rating.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty close flat while small, midcaps rally. What analysts are saying?
item.description: During a day marked by volatility, Indian stock market indices Sensex and Nifty concluded with minor dips, primarily due to oil prices nearing $105 per barrel, instilling caution in the investment community. Conversely, the Nifty Smallcap and Midcap indices thrived, achieving noteworthy gains. Experts suggest that despite pullbacks in IT and private banking segments, the market holds attractive valuations.

Aerospace stock Aequs plunges 19% after Q2 results. Why are investors worried?
item.description: Aequs shares fell sharply on Tuesday after the aerospace manufacturer’s Q2 FY27 net loss more than doubled to Rs 52 crore. Revenue rose 45% year-on-year, but EBITDA fell 45% and margins narrowed. Brokerages flagged weakness in the consumer business and delayed breakeven expectations, even as the aerospace order book remained strong.

item.title: India’s ₹1 lakh crore club stocks hit hard by FII exit. Have bluechips lost their growth engines?
item.description: India's largest corporations are experiencing a notable drop in foreign institutional investor stakes, raising concerns about their growth trajectory. This trend has adversely affected numerous large-cap stocks over recent months. Analysts suggest a shift in focus towards emerging sectors is critical for revitalizing foreign investments, as many companies now appear more like consistent cash flow generators than true growth catalysts.

item.title: Q2 earnings done for HDFC Bank, ICICI, other private lenders. What's next?
item.description: Private banks delivered mixed Q2 FY27 earnings, prompting analysts to identify lenders with attractive valuations and flag those investors may want to avoid. HDFC Bank reported a 5% YoY rise in net profit to Rs 19,510 crore, largely in line with expectations, but its shares have fallen 6% since the results.

item.title: Adani Ports SEZ Share Price Highlights: Adani Ports SEZ Stock Price History
Paytm shares rise 2% after Q2 results. What are Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, and others saying?
item.description: Paytm shares rose after the fintech major reported a 976% year-on-year jump in Q2 net profit and 28% revenue growth. Jefferies, Goldman Sachs and Citi retained Buy ratings, with target prices pointing to potential upside.

item.title: Tata Consumer shares rally over 4% after Q2 results. Why brokerages remain bullish despite target price cuts
item.description: Tata Consumer Products reported 16% year-on-year profit growth in Q2FY27, while brokerages retained positive ratings but cut target prices amid inflationary pressures. Jefferies, Nuvama, Elara Capital and Systematix see varying upside potential in the stock.

item.title: HAL, BEL, Paras Defence, other stocks rise up to 4% after DAC clears proposals worth Rs 2.12 lakh crore
item.description: India’s Defence Acquisition Council approved defence procurement proposals worth Rs 2.12 lakh crore, with 82% expected from domestic industry. The clearances cover helicopters, drones, air-defence systems, artillery and naval platforms, supporting military modernisation. Defence stocks may gain investor attention, while indigenous manufacturing, rising capital expenditure and policy support strengthen long-term sector growth prospects.
